rows.en: Crush his... Crush The O's ambitions for me.
Never mind that, I'm worried about you. Is your body gonna hold out?
Forget that, is your body even okay? You look like you're hurtin' bad.
More importantly, RX, it's your body I'm worried about.
But RX, what about your body...?
More importantly, will that body of yours hold out?
More importantly, will that body of yours hold out?
Never mind that, is your body gonna hold out? You look like you're hurting.
Don't worry about me... I'm not so weak that something like this will bring me down...
I can't fight at full strength... but never mind that. Go after The O.
We'll defeat The O, I promise!!
I see. Got it. We'll come back and save you later, count on it!!
Ya sure? Don't go actin' all tough, y'hear?
Anyway, leave The O to us, and you just wait right here!
Please leave The O to us!
So you made it all the way here. Impressive.
Where ya hidin'? Quit sneakin' around! Show yourself, dammit!!
Where are you!? Get out here and show yourself!
Unfortunately, this is as far as you go. The research has already entered its next stage.
Preparations for even more advanced, high-performance weapons are already underway.
Shut up!! Your ambitions end here!!
What are you saying!? Your ambitions end here!!
Silence! You're another one of this world's distortions!
Shut up! I will eliminate you!
Shut up!! Your ambitions end here!!
I kept quiet and listened, but... your ambitions end here, pal!!
Shut up!! Your ambitions end here!!
Shut up!! Your ambitions end right here!!

notes.note: Black RX, continuing from the King Stone line (story_038 #0.124); request form, addressed to the party. The self-correction ('his... The O's') is kept.

#0.126-0.143 are 9 leader-variant pairs (reply + concern for RX). Order taken from 0253.bla's second Pt_Chara_Check run (char ids 5,4,3,6,7,10,9,14,15): OOO, W (Shotaro), Den-O Sword (Momotaros), Nu, Zeta, 00, Wing Zero, Mebius, Zero. It matches the voices (rough pair is the 3rd, polite pairs 1st/5th/8th). The 'Zero' label on the first variant of each group is a mislabel; it is OOO's line.
#0.146-0.154 same 9-leader order, one line each. Source punctuation for OOO is two exclamation marks, kept.

#0.157-0.173 same 9-leader order, two lines each (OOO, W, Momotaros, Nu, Zeta, 00, Wing Zero, Mebius). Zero's variant has only #0.173: the table ends there, so the script's second Zero line (would be #0.174) does not exist in the table. Worth checking in-game.
'us' restored from the leader's own 'we' in the parallel variants; the source omits it here.
Momotaros doubting RX's 'I'm fine' (#0.155); 'tsuyogaru' = act tough.
Speaker shown as ??? (char 30) is The O, revealed in #0.3 onward.

#0.2-0.19 and #0.23-0.31 are leader variants in a different order: 0255.bla checks ids 7,6,10,9,5,4,3,14,15 = Zeta, Nu, 00, Wing Zero, OOO, W, Den-O Sword, Mebius, Zero. Confirmed by voice: rough line #0.14/#0.29 is 7th (Momotaros), 'distortion' #0.25 is 00, 'eliminate' #0.26 is Wing Zero, '-ze' ending #0.31 is Zero. 'Zero' labels on #0.2-0.3 and #0.23 are mislabels (Zeta).
Nu (Amuro) answering The O's boast; 'nani wo iu' rendered as an incredulous question.

report: 80/80 rows. Leader variants mapped from the event scripts' party-check order (0253: OOO, W, Momotaros, Nu, Zeta, 00, Wing Zero, Mebius, Zero; 0255: Zeta, Nu, 00, Wing Zero, OOO, W, Momotaros, Mebius, Zero); 'Zero' labels on first variants are mislabels. 0253 Zero variant at the end has no second line in the table (#0.174 missing). No new names or terms.
